patients.summary: Healthy marketing coordinator who joined in 2022 on a combined oral contraceptive. Perianal condylomata in early 2025 were biopsied and cleared with dermatology cryotherapy; a single perineal recurrence in early 2026 was treated by gynecology and resolved.

documents.title: New patient call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller wants to establish here, moving her care closer to home after her old office stopped taking new appointments in the evening. Healthy, no ongoing issues, on a birth control pill. Booked new patient physical 8/23 at 8:30. Membership packet and intake forms emailed. Asked her to bring pill bottle and the name of her last office so we can request records.

medications.drug_text: norgestimate 0.25 MG / ethinyl estradiol 0.035 MG Oral Tablet

orders.order: Records request, prior primary care office

documents.title: New Patient Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
28F here to establish. Was seeing a PCP group closer to her old apartment; wants somewhere she can actually reach by text. No complaints today.

PMH: none. Never had a chronic diagnosis.
PSH: tonsils out as a kid (age 8).
Meds: combined OCP — norgestimate/EE 0.25/0.035, one daily, on it for years without issues. No supplements.
Allergies: none to meds.
FH: mom — breast cancer at 55, treated, doing well. Dad — type 2 diabetes.
SH: works as a marketing coordinator, mostly desk and some events. Never smoked. 2-3 drinks a week, social. No drug use. Exercises a few times a week (runs, yoga).
Gyn: periods regular and light on the pill. Last Pap last year at old office, told normal — records requested.
ROS: negative across the board. No headaches, no leg swelling, no chest pain.

Exam: well-appearing. HEENT unremarkable, tonsils surgically absent. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement, no nodes. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin without rashes or concerning moles. Extremities without edema. Mood and affect normal.
PHQ-2: 0.

A/P
1. Health maintenance, healthy adult — BP normal on the pill, fine to continue estrogen-containing OCP (nonsmoker, no migraine with aura, no clot history). Refills through us going forward.
2. FH breast cancer in mother at 55 — plan screening mammography starting at 40; no earlier imaging indicated by this history alone. Will revisit if more family history surfaces.
3. FH T2DM — glucose with routine labs next year.
4. Records request to old office for Pap and vaccine history.
Flu and COVID shots when available this fall. RTC 1 year.

reports.text: Specimen: ThinPrep liquid-based cervical cytology. Adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
reports.conclusion: Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Received 14 pages from patient's previous primary care practice covering 2017-2022. Contents: annual visit notes (healthy, no chronic problems), OCP prescriptions, immunization record with Tdap 4/2019, cervical cytology 7/2021 NILM. No other labs or imaging of note. Abstracted Pap and Tdap into chart; full packet in media tab for PCP review.

documents.title: Outside records review
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Reviewed old office records. Nothing new — healthy, Pap 2021 normal, Tdap 2019. Next cervical screen due 2024. Signed.

documents.title: Immunization visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In on her lunch hour for vaccines. No fever or illness today, no prior reactions. Flu (quadrivalent) L deltoid, Pfizer bivalent booster R deltoid. Lot numbers in MAR. Observed 15 min, no reaction. VIS given.

documents.title: OCP refill
documents.author: MA
documents.body: E-refill request from retail pharmacy for norgestimate/ethinyl estradiol 0.25/0.035, 3-month supply. Last physical 8/2022, BP normal. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly check. Feels well. Busy season at work, sleeping OK. Still running a couple times a week.
Meds: OCP, taking daily, no breakthrough bleeding.
No headaches, no calf pain, no chest pain or shortness of breath.
Alcohol unchanged, 2-3/wk. Nonsmoker.

Exam: NAD. Vitals reviewed, BP fine. Thyroid not enlarged. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen benign. No edema. Skin: no suspicious lesions on visible skin. Breast exam deferred per patient preference, will do next year.
PHQ-2: 0.

A/P
- Well adult. Continue OCP.
- Labs: CBC, CMP (fasting glucose given dad's diabetes), lipids.
- One-time HIV and hep C screens — discussed, she agrees.
- Pap due next year.
- Flu/COVID in October.
See in a year.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Beth — everything from Tuesday came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, fasting sugar, cholesterol. HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative, and those don't need repeating unless something changes. Nothing to do here. Enjoy the rest of the summer.

documents.title: Immunization visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Seasonal vaccines. Feeling well, afebrile. Last year: sore arm only. Influenza given L deltoid, 2023-24 COVID (Pfizer) R deltoid. Tolerated, waited 15 minutes, left ambulatory.
